book_goal: Turn a bankrupt underdog guild into an economic and political empire using strategy, arbitrage, divine auctions, and guild management.

acts.title: The Ledger Awakens
acts.objective: Rescue the guild from debt and establish its first avenues of leverage.

arcs.title: Opening the Ledger
arcs.objective: Create the first tactical and political wins for the guild.

beats.description: Lys confronts the failing guild and identifies the first leverage points.
The guild secures its first charter and survives the first wave of predation.
A sabotage campaign tests the guild's reputation and resilience.

open_obligations: Convert early leverage into durable market share.

acts.title: Market Dominion
acts.objective: Expand guild influence through logistics, auctions, and cartel disruption.

arcs.title: Consolidation
arcs.objective: Establish the guild as a capable commercial power.

beats.description: The guild wins a new trade lane and secures a logistics base.
A dangerous credit line forces the guild to balance growth and risk.
A bold auction bid turns a district into a strategic prize.

open_obligations: Convince allies and creditors that the guild is viable.

acts.title: Imperial Ledger
acts.objective: Seize monopoly rights and transform the guild into a kingdom-scale empire.

arcs.title: Ascension
arcs.objective: Convert strategic gains into a sovereign guild empire.

beats.description: The guild fractures a cartel and redefines the market.
A blessing-license auction decides the guild's spiritual and political legitimacy.
The guild wins a critical charter and dungeon corridor.
The guild emerges as a new sovereign economic power.

open_obligations: Sustain growth without collapsing under debt.
Secure the guild's legitimacy as a true power center.

criteria: The guild survives the cartel wars.
The guild secures a durable monopoly core and the first outlines of a sovereign kingdom.
book_boundary.notes: The story reaches a satisfying empire-building outcome in which the guild becomes a new sovereign power rather than a mere insurgent faction.
